Exercise: SEATED SINGLE-LEG HAMSTRING STRETCH. Sit on one plain thin charcoal yoga mat, one leg extended forward with knee nearly straight but not locked, heel on mat and toes up; other knee bends outward, sole rests toward inner thigh of extended leg. Pelvis supported, torso hinges gently forward from hips with long back rather than collapsing onto leg. Both hands rest lightly on extended leg shin, no forced toe reach, shoulders relaxed and neck natural. Side-rear three-quarter camera shows extended leg, posterior/outer thigh, bent other leg, hands and full mat. Coral on exposed HAMSTRING bellies of extended leg below shorts only, no quads, knees, calves or back. Here coral indicates stretch TARGET region, not activation. Clothing opaque, no color painted on shorts. No equipment beyond mat.

review.notes: Supported seated hip hinge, extended heel down with toes up and hands lightly on shin. Posterior thigh target coral, no color through shorts. Other bent leg and second hand are partly occluded by side angle; still shows one side only.
